title: Cline — one turn, end to end
example_input: add a retry helper to src/utils.ts and run the tests
note: Act mode, default auto-approvals. Pinned at v4.1.22.

steps.title: Input (webview)
steps.narrative: The user types 'add a retry helper to src/utils.ts and run the tests' in the VS Code sidebar, act mode. handleSendMessage calls TaskServiceClient.newTask() — a generated ProtoBusClient subclass. The webview postMessages {type: 'grpc_request', ...} to the host; the model-facing loop never sees this wire, it only ever sees SDK events.
steps.representation:
user text
  → handleSendMessage()
  → TaskServiceClient.newTask({text})
  → postMessage({type: 'grpc_request', service, method, payload})

steps.title: Host dispatch
steps.narrative: handleGrpcRequest routes to the generated serviceHandlers[service][method] table, landing in SdkController.handleTaskCreation → initTask, which coordinates the task-start sequence.

steps.title: Session build
steps.narrative: cline-session-factory builds the session config: mode act selects ToolPresets.act, maxIterations: undefined, per-mode model keys. VscodeSessionHost.start → ClineCore.start → a SessionRuntime → createAgentRuntime with the 9 default tools plus MCP server__tool natives. One quiet substitution: VS Code suppresses the SDK shell tool (toolExecutors.bash = undefined) and registers its own terminal-backed run_commands under the identical name — same policy key, different execution semantics.
steps.representation:
{mode: 'act', maxIterations: undefined, model: actMode*}
  → VscodeSessionHost.start()
  → ClineCore.start() → SessionRuntime
  → createAgentRuntime({tools: 9 builtins + server__tool natives})
  → toolExecutors.bash = undefined  // VS Code re-skins run_commands

steps.title: Prompt assembly
steps.narrative: buildClineSystemPrompt renders the ACT base template, replacing {{PLATFORM_NAME}}, {{CURRENT_DATE}}, {{IDE_NAME}}, {{CWD}}, {{CLINE_RULES}}, {{CLINE_METADATA}}. Then MessageBuilder normalizes the message list for the API: truncation budgets, missing-tool-result repair, sticky outdated-rewrite decisions.
steps.representation:
ACT template
  → replace {{IDE_NAME}}='Visual Studio Code', {{CWD}}, {{CLINE_RULES}}…
  → MessageBuilder.normalize()
    → truncation budgets, missing-tool-result repair
  → messages[] ready for the gateway

steps.title: Checkpoint
steps.narrative: The beforeModel hook fires — iteration 1 only — and snapshots the worktree: git stash create, plus a synthesized third-parent commit for untracked files, pinned under the private ref refs/cline/checkpoints/{session}/{runCount} in the user's own repository, via a persistent per-session GIT_INDEX_FILE so the user's index is never disturbed.
steps.representation:
beforeModel({snapshot})  // iteration === 1 only
  → git stash create  (+ 3rd-parent commit for untracked)
  → update-ref refs/cline/checkpoints/{session}/{runCount} <sha>
  // in the USER's repo — no shadow repo, despite the docs

steps.title: Model call
steps.narrative: DefaultGateway.stream() → registry.resolveModel() does an exact-ID match against the provider catalog (unknown IDs fall back to an unregistered-model path, not an error) → capability gates → the family factory builds a Vercel AI SDK provider → streamText. Tokens stream back as runtime events.
steps.representation:
messages[]
  → DefaultGateway.stream()
  → registry.resolveModel(modelId)  // exact-ID match
  → createAiSdkProvider(...) → streamText()
  → token events → runtime

steps.title: Tool dispatch
steps.narrative: The model emits read_files and editor calls. prepareToolExecution resolves the policy: VS Code forces autoApprove: false on every governed tool so the SDK always consults the live UI; the approval callback applies the live settings — reads, edits, browser, MCP auto-approved by default; commands prompt by default. read_files and editor run; each result is appended.
steps.representation:
tool calls: read_files, editor
  → prepareToolExecution()
    → resolveToolPolicy()  // '*' then per-name; VS Code forces autoApprove:false
    → approval callback: reads/edits auto-approved, commands prompt
  → execute (sequential) → results appended

steps.title: Feedback & loop
steps.narrative: Tool results feed the next iteration. When the model calls run_commands for the tests, the approval callback prompts in the webview — edits get a diff preview rendered from a virtual document ('the real file is never opened or modified by the preview'); command asks get buttons. A denial comes back with 'The user denied this edit. The file was NOT modified…' plus TOOL_REJECTION_SUFFIX, fed to the model as a tool error.
steps.representation:
results → next iteration
  run_commands('npm test')
    → approval callback → webview prompt (buttons)
    → yes: run unsandboxed in user shell
    → no:  'The user denied this edit. The file was NOT modified…'
           + TOOL_REJECTION_SUFFIX → tool error → model

steps.title: Termination & render
steps.narrative: No more tool calls, no completion reminders → finishRun('completed') → run-finished. WebviewGrpcBridge translates SDK events into ClineMessages → proto → the webview's subscribeToPartialMessage / subscribeToState streams → the convergent-replica reducer renders the transcript. /undo calls SdkController.restoreCheckpoint: refuse if HEAD moved past the checkpoint, else update-ref HEAD + reset --hard + conditional clean -fd + stash apply, guarded by a pre-restore transaction snapshot.
steps.representation:
finishRun('completed') → run-finished
  → WebviewGrpcBridge: SDK events → ClineMessage[]
  → proto → subscribeToPartialMessage / subscribeToState
  → convergent-replica reducer → React transcript
  /undo → restoreCheckpoint: update-ref HEAD + reset --hard (+ tx snapshot)
